description:
The Pathani Samanta Mathematics Talent Scholarship Scheme is a government initiative aimed at promoting mathematical talent among students in the state of Odisha, India. 

This scheme was launched in the year 2016. 

It is named after the renowned mathematician Pathani Samanta, who made significant contributions to mathematics in the 19th century. 

The primary objective of the scheme is to encourage students from economically weaker sections to pursue higher education in mathematics and related fields. 

The scheme specifically targets students studying in Class 11 and Class 12. 

The government aims to identify and nurture talented students who show a keen interest in mathematics. 

The scholarship provides financial assistance to eligible students to help them continue their education without financial burden. 

The scholarship amount is set at INR 5,000 per annum for each selected student. 

This financial support is intended to cover various educational expenses such as books, study materials, and tuition fees. 

The scheme is designed to benefit students from both government and private schools. 

To be eligible for the scholarship, students must be residents of Odisha. 

Students must be enrolled in Class 11 or Class 12 in a recognized school. 

The scheme is open to students who have secured at least 60 percent marks in their Class 10 board examinations. 

Additionally, the family income of the applicant should not exceed INR 6 lakh per annum. 

This income criterion is set to ensure that the benefits reach the economically weaker sections of society. 

The application process for the scholarship is straightforward and involves several steps. 

Students must fill out the application form available on the official website of the Odisha government. 

The application form requires personal details such as name, address, and educational qualifications. 

Students must also provide details about their family income and attach relevant documents as proof. 

Documents required for the application include a copy of the Class 10 mark sheet, income certificate, and proof of residence. 

Once the application is completed, it must be submitted to the designated authority in the respective district. 

The deadline for submitting applications is typically set at the beginning of the academic year. 

Students are advised to keep track of announcements regarding the application timeline. 

The selection process is based on the merit of the applicants. 

Shortlisted candidates are notified through official communication from the education department. 

The scholarship amount is disbursed directly into the bank accounts of the selected students. 

This disbursement usually occurs at the beginning of the academic session. 

The implementing authority for the Pathani Samanta Mathematics Talent Scholarship Scheme is the Department of School and Mass Education, Government of Odisha. 

For any inquiries or assistance, students can contact the department through their official website or helpline numbers. 

The scheme has seen a positive response since its inception. 

It has encouraged many students to take an interest in mathematics and pursue further studies in the field. 

The government aims to increase the number of beneficiaries each year. 

This initiative is part of a broader effort to improve educational outcomes in Odisha. 

The scheme aligns with the national goal of enhancing the quality of education in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics) fields. 

The government has also introduced various workshops and training programs to complement the scholarship. 

These programs aim to provide additional support to students in developing their mathematical skills. 

The Pathani Samanta Mathematics Talent Scholarship Scheme is a critical step towards fostering a culture of excellence in mathematics among young learners. 

It not only provides financial assistance but also motivates students to excel academically. 

The scheme is part of the Odisha government's commitment to improving educational access and equity. 

By focusing on mathematics, the government aims to build a strong foundation for future generations. 

The initiative has the potential to create a pool of talented mathematicians who can contribute to various fields. 

This includes engineering, data science, finance, and research. 

The scholarship scheme is regularly reviewed and updated to meet the changing needs of students. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is taken into account to improve the program. 

The government encourages students to take full advantage of this opportunity. 

By doing so, they can enhance their educational prospects and career opportunities. 

The Pathani Samanta Mathematics Talent Scholarship Scheme is a beacon of hope for many aspiring mathematicians in Odisha. 

It underscores the importance of supporting education at all levels. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's dedication to nurturing talent and promoting academic excellence. 

In conclusion, the Pathani Samanta Mathematics Talent Scholarship Scheme is a vital initiative that provides financial support and encouragement to students pursuing mathematics in Odisha. 

It aims to create a conducive environment for learning and growth in the field of mathematics. 

Through this scheme, the government hopes to inspire a new generation of mathematicians who will contribute to society and the economy. 

Students interested in applying for the scholarship should stay informed about the application process and deadlines. 

By taking proactive steps, they can secure the financial assistance they need to succeed in their academic pursuits.
